goal: Reduce excessive '[error]'/'[warning]' log noise introduced by an earlier PR (#29236) that over-promoted many routine failures to error level.
Adds a LogWarnThenDebug() helper that warns once then demotes to debug, for problems likely caused by system misconfiguration but triggerable repeatedly by remote peers.
Also tightens a couple of silent failure paths (AddCScript, LoadCScript) by marking them [[nodiscard]] so callers can't ignore errors.

l0rinc gave concept ACK and lightly-tested ACK, noting several unresolved style nits but no blocking issue (l0rinc).
sedited and kevkevinpal also approved after clarifying discussion (sedited, kevkevinpal).

result.summary: This PR walks back some of the log-level escalation from an earlier PR (#29236) that turned many routine internal failures into LogError/LogWarning noise, downgrading several of them back to Info/Debug across netbase, txindex, coinstats, and validation. It introduces a new LogWarnThenDebug() helper that emits a warning the first time a code path is hit and demotes subsequent occurrences to a debug-level, categorized message, intended for failures likely caused by system misconfiguration but triggerable repeatedly by remote peers (e.g. PCP/NAT-PMP, SOCKS5 proxy errors). It also makes AddCScript/LoadCScript [[nodiscard]] and has bitcoin-tx and a wallet test check their return values instead of silently ignoring failures. The change touches many small call sites (13 files) but each individual hunk is a log-level or messaging tweak rather than a logic change.
result.problem: Node operators and developers experience excessive or misclassified log messages: routine, often-benign or remote-triggerable conditions were logged at LogError/LogWarning severity after #29236 turned the old error() helper into LogError, making genuinely serious warnings harder to spot amid noise. The author states this "reduces some of the exaggerated logging that was introduced in #29236."

open_concerns: ryanofsky: downgrading LogError/LogWarning to Debug in several netbase paths (especially SOCKS5 handshake errors) loses the '[error]'/'[warning]' tags that make it easy to spot real problems, and could hide recurring failures if warn-once-then-debug is applied to intermittent (not just misconfiguration) issues; raised as Concept -0 / Approach -0 across two review rounds, not addressed by a code change, agreed to disagree.

l0rinc: several message-wording nits (redeemScript vs redeemScripts, adding sizes/details to txindex and coinstats messages, GetBindAddress error logging) left unaddressed; author has not replied to all of them.

l0rinc: questioned whether the wallet_tests.cpp fix for AddCScript's nodiscard actually exercises the intended code path, suggesting the test passes even with a stub implementation; not resolved in the thread.
resolved_concerns: sedited's confusion about when Debug vs LogWarnThenDebug is used in netbase was clarified by the author (Proxy::Connect vs ConnectDirectly severity reasoning) and sedited accepted the explanation.
l0rinc's suggestion to fix the double-negation in the LogWarnThenDebug macro implementation was taken by the author.
l0rinc's request for a unit test of LogWarnThenDebug was implemented by the author in a later push.
kevkevinpal's suggestion to add a filter category to LogWarning/LogWarning-based calls was clarified as inapplicable since those macros aren't filterable.

uncertainties: Whether the netbase log-level changes materially reduce operators' ability to diagnose recurring proxy/connection problems, as ryanofsky warned, is unresolved by evidence in the thread either way.
Whether the wallet_tests.cpp change actually validates the intended AddCScript behavior is disputed by l0rinc and not addressed by the author in the visible discussion.
No explicit project-level signal (issue, roadmap) establishes how much this log-noise problem bothers users beyond the participating reviewers' opinions.
result.card: This PR walks back over-eager log-level escalation from an earlier PR (#29236), downgrading many LogError/LogWarning messages in netbase, txindex, coinstats, and validation back to Info/Debug, and adds a LogWarnThenDebug() helper that warns once then demotes to debug for recurring, remote-triggerable, likely-misconfiguration failures (used for PCP/NAT-PMP and several netbase cases). It also makes AddCScript/LoadCScript [[nodiscard]] and has bitcoin-tx throw instead of silently ignoring a failed redeemScript load, closing a small correctness gap in a transaction-building tool. The strongest evidence of value is the author's own framing that #29236 was overzealous, echoed by five reviewers approving, but ryanofsky maintains a standing, unresolved Concept/Approach -0 that removing '[error]'/'[warning]' tags makes real problems harder to spot, and l0rinc separately questions whether the wallet test change actually exercises the intended safety fix. The PR is Ready for review, having been rebased and updated as recently as 2026-08-15 with no material blocking question outstanding. It has no hard dependency but is conceptually linked to the open PR #34730, which proposes combining the warning/error log levels.
